Officers in the Sith Military often take on a multi-role position when deployed, and the imperial efficiency with which they are assigned their posts ensures that their specific talents are maximized. Commander Nather specializes in planetary sciences and assists in the research efforts on Korriban, doubling as the Chief Science Officer and the garrison quartermaster.

These small droids are widespread. The term "utility droid" is used for many different models that varied widely in form and function. Some of them are at times referred as "astromech droids." 

Some models are used for advanced applied physics functions such as starship repair, astrogating, and even computer slicing and programming. Others perform more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.

Almost all are under one meter tall. They are equipped either with wheeled legs or small repulsorlift generators for movement, and painted the colours of their owner or simply left unadorned.

The Revanites are a splinter faction of Malak's Sith Empire. After Revan's fall, they are those who took issue with Malak's new, more destructive war, and threw in with Lord Valerius, supporting his rebellion against the Darth and bid to claim the title of Dark Lord of the Sith. For some their loyalty is to Valerius, others to their idea of who Revan was and what he stood for, others simply take issue with Darth Malak, and some still seek out the Revanites for their less despicable tendencies as far as Sith go, seeing them more as the Jedi Crusaders of the late Mandalorian Wars than the monsters that compose the Sith Empire. Regardless, they are still followers of the Dark Side.

The Revanites promote competition amongst their ranks, both among the Force Sensitives among their number and their rank and file troops. Those the most merciless, cruel and powerful amongst them are elevated, while those exhibiting softer tendencies are treated like fodder and find death sooner rather than later - often from friendly fire.

These are the former among them. Clad in finer armor and given access to the newest in Imperial weapons technology as reward for their faithful service to the Sith.

Clad in silvery armor, these men and women are a menace to the galaxy. Many of them were once Republic Troopers, veterans of the Mandalorian Wars and saviors of the Republic, who have now become traitor and answer not to the Senate but to Darth Malak and his inner circle. Others are more recent recruits, whether pressed into service or eager ot make the most of Imperial rule by siding with their new overlords.
